children: Here’s a challenge. Using the five clues below, identify the company that is being talked about here.
1 I just completed 30 years of being listed and was founded by the pioneer of my business, who had no academic credentials. All three of his sons are on the board, which is now 10 members strong.
2 A globally-renowned fund remained the largest non-promoter shareholder for seven years until 2021 and then exited. My stock price moved almost 10 times higher within three years of their exit.

3 In 2025, my operating profit was higher than the annual sales of any year prior to Covid. My spectacular profit growth came without compromising return on equity, which has remained above 20 per cent over the previous three, five and 10 years.
4 Despite losing almost half my value last year, I have still delivered returns of more than 25 per cent per annum  to my shareholders over the last three, five and 10 years.
5 My number of shareholders has grown fivefold over the last three years, even though I have been a listed company for more than 30 years. Currently, 40 per cent is owned by the retail public.

title: Who Am I? November 8, 2026
